description: Search for symbols. Search for symbols by text, type, country, or exchange. → Returns {current_page: number, has_more: boolean, symbols: [{name: string, code: string, type: string, exchange: string, currency_code: string, country: string, description: string}]}. ALWAYS start here to find the correct standard symbol code unless you already know it. InsightSentry uses EXCHANGE:SYMBOL format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL) which differs from other platforms. Do NOT guess codes — search first. Use exchange to limit results to one exchange; call list_exchanges to discover exchange prefixes. For SIP: codes, use list_sip_symbols. Use the returned code with get_quotes, get_symbol_series, get_symbol_info, or any other standard market-data tool.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

page.description: Each page returns up to 50 results.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

name: search_symbols
